backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the fuel station management backend, defining core types (Tank, Sale, Shift, Staff, Expense) and state management with role-based access control, Stripe integration, and HTTP outcalls.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting two implemented features: full application responsiveness with mobile-friendly navigation, and ShiftManagement date/time picker enhancements for all staff members.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-line summaries of all frontend source files, serving as a reference index for the components, hooks, and pages in the React frontend.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS entry point with Tailwind directives and OKLCH-based CSS custom property design tokens for light and dark themes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Vite/React app, setting viewport meta, the page title 'Fuel Inventory Management', and mounting the React root.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that sets up TanStack Router with all application routes, wraps them in an AuthGuard handling Internet Identity login and profile setup, and provides theme and toast context.
frontend/src/components/AlertsPanel.tsx: Alerts dashboard component that fetches tank data and displays active low-fuel alerts and normal-status tanks with threshold details and a link to update tank levels.
Displays sales analytics using Recharts, including a line chart for sales trends over time and bar charts comparing petrol vs diesel revenue, volume, and transaction counts.
frontend/src/components/CashCollectionEn: Provides a form to record daily cash collections and displays a table of past collections, along with summary cards showing today's sales revenue, cash collected, and any discrepancy.
frontend/src/components/CommissionCalcul: Calculates and displays earned commissions for each staff member based on their sales totals and commission rates, shown in a summary table with aggregate stats.
frontend/src/components/Dashboard.tsx: Main dashboard overview showing key metrics (active alerts, current shift, today's revenue, tank levels) as clickable cards, plus an informational banner about mobile APK generation.
Provides the main app shell with a responsive sidebar navigation (including admin-only items), mobile drawer menu, user profile display, and logout functionality.
frontend/src/components/ExpenseLogger.ts: Form component for logging station expenses by category with offline support, displaying a categorized breakdown and a table of all recorded expenses.
frontend/src/components/FuelTypeAnalytic: Displays a comparative analytics dashboard for petrol vs diesel sales, showing volume, revenue, transaction count, and percentage breakdowns fetched via the useGetSales hook.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Renders a login/logout button using Internet Identity authentication, handling login state transitions and clearing the React Query cache on logout.
frontend/src/components/OfflineStatusInd: Shows a status bar indicating online/offline connectivity, pending sync count, sync progress, and a manual sync button, using connection monitor and auto-sync hooks.
frontend/src/components/PaymentFailure.t: Displays a payment failure message card with a link to return to the dashboard.
frontend/src/components/PaymentSuccess.t: Displays a payment success confirmation card with a link to return to the dashboard.
frontend/src/components/PriceUpdateModul: Admin-only module that shows current petrol/diesel prices, allows updating them via a form, and displays price history using backend query and mutation hooks.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: Renders a profile creation form collecting name, phone number, and staff role, then saves the profile via the useSaveCallerUserProfile mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/ProfitLossDashbo: Displays a financial overview dashboard with total revenue, expenses, net profit/loss, and profit margin cards, plus a revenue breakdown section, derived from combined sales and expenses data.
frontend/src/components/SalesForm.tsx: A form component for recording fuel sales that supports both online and offline modes, allowing users to select fuel type, quantity, staff member, totalizer readings, and sale date/time before submitting to the backend or saving locally.
frontend/src/components/SalesReports.tsx: Displays sales analytics with daily/weekly/monthly filtering, showing total revenue, petrol and diesel breakdowns by volume and revenue, and a detailed transaction table.
Manages staff shifts by allowing users to start new shifts with a selected staff member and datetime, and end active shifts via a dialog with a configurable end datetime.
frontend/src/components/ShiftReport.tsx: Renders a read-only report of all shifts sorted by ID, displaying staff name, start/end times, number of sales, total revenue, and active/completed status.
Provides CRUD operations for staff members, including adding staff with optional Principal ID validation, editing existing staff details, and removing staff, with role and commission rate management.
frontend/src/components/StockReconciliat: Displays a daily stock reconciliation table comparing calculated vs actual closing fuel volumes per tank, highlighting variances with badges.
frontend/src/components/TankMonitor.tsx: Renders a tank monitoring dashboard with progress-bar fuel level indicators and dialogs for adding new tanks or updating existing tank levels.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an ICP backend actor using the current Internet Identity, initializing access control with an admin token and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAutoSync.ts: Automatically triggers syncing of offline-stored data to the backend when connectivity is restored, then invalidates relevant React Query caches on success.
Monitors both browser online status and backend reachability by periodically calling a health-check endpoint, exposing a combined connection state.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and provider, managing AuthClient creation, login/logout flow, and persisting identity across page reloads.
frontend/src/hooks/useOfflineStorage.ts: Manages offline persistence of sales and expenses in localStorage, exposing helpers to add, clear, and query pending records.
frontend/src/hooks/useOnlineStatus.ts: Tracks the browser's online/offline status by listening to the corresponding window events and returns a boolean.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend data operations including tanks, sales, expenses, staff, shifts, cash collections, price updates, and user profiles using the actor pattern.
frontend/src/hooks/useSyncOfflineData.ts: Hook that syncs locally stored offline sales and expenses to the backend via the actor, tracking sync progress and error state.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that sets up Tailwind directives and defines OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped in QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage fallback support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the theme with OKLCH color tokens, custom border radii, accordion animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animate.
project_state.json: Project state metadata describing the petrol station management app's existing features, pending feature requests (responsive design and shift date/time selection), and architectural notes.
